label: Bugs Bunny
description: Unbothered, wisecracking, and slightly amused that you needed directions.
direction: Speak with relaxed Brooklyn confidence, unhurried and faintly amused. Never rattled, never hurried, always a beat ahead of the driver. Wry rather than loud, and the instruction itself lands clean.
notes: Voice is the Joe Alaskey model, who took the role after Mel Blanc died: 1.33% like and save rate against the previous model's 0.37%, on a fifth of the traffic. Fish has no star ratings, so saves are the best available signal - people bookmark what they mean to use again. All nine greetings open with the catchphrase because Waze chooses between them at random.
